title: Downtown Denver Haunted Walking Tour (Family Friendly)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our Haunted Denver Ghost Tour is a family friendly activity that will take you on a walking tour to explore the fascinating haunted history of Denver and its many ghost stories. 

A costumed tour guide will lead guests on a journey through downtown Denver and reveal some of its most famous and creepy haunted stories. Visit several of the oldest buildings in Denver and walk its historic streets, where the past may not be as buried as it seems. 

Tours last about 1.5 hours. It is a walking tour so comfortable shoes are recommended.
